But I'm gonna let it slide this time, cause it's so cute!|[[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]] upon discovery of a satellite receiver inside a patron's baggage|<ref name="Star Tours: The Adventures Continue">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>}}
A '''satellite receiver''' was a type of technological device in use by [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was occasionally banned from civilian interstellar travel such as by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency, at least among checked baggage.

During the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the security droid in charge of checking baggage, [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]], discovered a satellite receiver inside a passenger's checked baggage. Despite it being prohibited, he decided to let it slide as he found it to be "cute," also suggesting that the passenger keep it a secret from his supervisor.
